name: Mark Omo
biography: Mark Omo is a professional security researcher and engineer, but mostly a fearless leader, a job which he definitely loves way more than actually hacking things. Mark has a background in Consumer and Medical and Aerospace products. He spends his days making PowerPoints and his nights hacking away on embedded hardware.
